programs.mainnetDeploymentNote: The V1 Pinocchio program (escrow, registry, rating, attestation, delivery check and pooled Budget in one program) deploys to the same id as devnet. Runbook section 5 sets mainnetDeploymentStatusNote to "deployed" once sections 3 and 4 have passed for this id; until then the resolver keeps the mainnet profile blocked and nothing signs against it.
